versions.changelog:
- Major refactor to modularize coaching methods: all "四种赋能方式" content moved to a new reference file (`references/coaching-methods.md`).
- Metadata structure improved: skill attributes (version, triggers, formats) are now structured under `metadata` at the top of the file.
- File organization updated: added `references/coaching-methods.md`, removed deprecated `skill-card.md`.
- User documentation updated to reflect new loading and organizational approach; reference usage is now explicit.
- No functional changes to core coaching logic—workflow and evaluation principles maintained.

- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- Minor version update to 1.7.0.
- No content changes made to SKILL.md.

- Added slug and displayName fields for improved skill identification.
- Updated version to 1.6.3.
- Removed deprecated file: skill-card.md.
- No changes to logic or content structure; documentation fields improved for clarity and consistency.

Version 1.6.0 introduces traceability, safety guidance, and structured depth/error requirements:

- Added unique ID (COACH-XXXX) tracking for each coaching plan to support traceability.
- Defined minimum depth requirements for empowerment plans and included quantification guidelines.
- Introduced error recovery guidance for handling unaddressed skill gaps.
- Added explicit security warning and data handling limitations to prevent misuse and support compliance.
- Moved output structure and requirements out of examples into clearly structured metadata fields.
- Removed skill-card.md, consolidating all documentation into SKILL.md.

Version 1.5.0

- Updated SKILL.md with new structure and output formats, emphasizing coaching plans, skill matrices, and progress metrics.
- Enhanced skill description for clarity and practical application scenarios.
- Added explicit input and output format definitions for more structured usage.
- Removed the legacy skill-card.md file.

- Description now emphasizes沉淀经验为checklist/模板/培训材料，通过Pair测试等方式提升团队能力
- 精简描述信息，去除关键词与触发场景的冗余表达
- 删除 skill-card.md 文件，保留核心技能说明
- 其余内容及结构保持一致，未新增功能或核心用法变化

- Expanded skill description to include new keywords: 测试思维培养、技能矩阵、导师制、知识库建设、能力提升
- Added more trigger words in when_to_use, such as "带人"、"培养"、"团队成长"、新成员加入需要快速上手
- Removed the file skill-card.md
- No changes to the core logic or functionality of the skill

- 增加了四种团队赋能方式（Checklist、模板、Review、Pair）的详细介绍及应用场景  
- 新增了新人培训大纲、培训练习设计、能力评估体系及相关示例  
- 明确了每种赋能方式和培训材料的设计原则  
- 丰富了实际应用示例，便于不同情景下快速采用  
- 加入团队赋能后自查项，提升实践落地性
